title: packet-btle: dissection of several control packets used in Channel Sounding procedure
description:
- LL_CS_CHANNEL_MAP_IND
- LL_CS_SEC_REQ/RSP
- LL_CS_TERMINATE_REQ/RSP
- LL_CS_IND
- LL_CS_RSP
- LL_CS_REQ
- LL_CS_CONFIG_RSP

commits_data.title: packet-btle: LL_CS_CHANNEL_MAP_IND dissection
commits_data.message:
packet-btle: LL_CS_CHANNEL_MAP_IND dissection

added support of LL_CS_CHANNEL_MAP_IND packets
according to Bluetooth Core Specification 6.0,
Vol. 6, Part B, 2.4.2.53 LL_CS_CHANNEL_MAP_IND

Signed-off-by: Ivan Iushkov <ivan.iushkov@nordicsemi.no>
